maya: Quick heads-up — after the int8 bring-up for openembed-large I see a consistent recall@1 drop on internal-docs-10k. Notebook + raw logs: https://redwood.s3/qa/openembed-int8-1718.zip. Can someone triage?
jonah: Saw this too on ms-marco. Float16 R@1 = 0.623, int8 R@1 = 0.582. R@10 0.890 -> 0.861. Small but consistent across seeds.
priya: Do we have per-slice numbers? Short queries vs long? Cosine vs L2 behavior? Could be norm shift.
samir: Quick local check on a 1k subsample: mean L2 increased by ~0.03, std up as well. Looks like quantization noise adds a small bias. Snippet I ran: ```python
# compute norms
embs = load('emb_int8.npy')
means = np.mean(np.linalg.norm(embs, axis=1))
print(means)
```
eval-bot: Eval summary uploaded. Key points: affected slices = short queries (<3 tokens), multi-sentence docs (embedding blends). Absolute R@1 delta on short queries = -4.1%. Overall R@1 delta = -4.1 to -4.2 pts depending on seed. Full table: https://redwood.s3/qa/reports/1718-summary.csv
maya: Thanks. Hypothesis: per-channel scale or asymmetric quant might reduce bias. Also double-check exporter ordering (transpose/permute) when converting to int8 — could be subtle reorder.
jonah: I'll try per-channel symmetric vs asymmetric and ONNXRuntime int8 vs custom kernel. Running sweep now (per-channel/asym/symmetric, clip params). ETA ~30m.
priya: Also suggest trying unit-normalize embeddings before indexing (L2 norm). That often mitigates cosine shift and makes quant noise less harmful.
samir: Quick test: int8 index + unit-normalize before indexing -> R@1 recovered to 0.61 on the 1k subsample (was 0.582 -> 0.61). Still ~0.01 below fp16 baseline. Uploading diagnostic plots: https://redwood.s3/qa/plots/1718-norm-check.png
maya: Good signal. If per-channel + normalization gets us within noise of fp16 we can enable int8 for Dedicated only, and gate on per-model eval thresholds. If not, rollback and open a deeper quant-tuning task.
jonah: Update: per-channel asymmetric quant + bias correction gave R@1=0.621 on internal-docs, and 0.618 on ms-marco quick sweep. Running full ms-marco sweep now.
priya: Nice. Can you include cosine vs dotprod tables (pre/post-normalize) in the sweep? Also add short-query holdout to CI evals.
maya: Action items: 1) jonah: full sweep + bake per-channel asymmetric config and docs (due EOD). 2) samir: open PR to add unit-normalize option in indexing pipeline + tests. 3) priya: add holdout short-queries slice to CI regression checks. 4) maya: prepare rollout plan (canary in Dedicated only). I'll create the rollout ticket and link results.
priya: :thumbsup: will add CI test case.
eval-bot: Recording final numbers + artifacts to experiment-tracking (exp_id=emb-q1718).
maya: Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread and paste final ms-marco numbers. Closing loop once sweep finishes.
